Name: MULTI_ESTUS_FLASK_BONUS_PARAM_ST
Description: Flask charges restored when another player in the session is defeated. The row is picked by how the receiving player joined: 0 host or no join type (only while a session condition is met; otherwise nothing is given), 1000/1100/1200 cooperator by summon sign (None/Umbasa/Berserker), 2000/2100/2200 red summon sign invader, 3000/3500/3600 invader, 4000/4100 hunter 1/2, 5000 Forest guardian, 5100 Anor guardian, 6000 arena, 7000 Yellow Monk. The column is picked the same way for the defeated player. MultiHPEstusFlaskBonusParam gives Crimson Flask charges, MultiMPEstusFlaskBonusParam Cerulean Flask charges; charges are only given while the player holds fewer than their flask allotment. Shared by both params.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Host
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is the host (or has no join type). Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - White Phantom - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - White Phantom - Gold
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a gold (Umbasa join type) cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - White Phantom - Berserker
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a Berserker join type cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is an invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - Gold
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a gold (Umbasa join type) invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - Berserker
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a Berserker join type invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - None - Invasion

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - Gold - Invasion

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - Berserker - Invasion
